contracts.answer_exemplar: 半导体设备公司的 AI read-through 不能写成“AI capex 增长，所以 ASML / AMAT / LRCX / KLAC 都受益”。AI 需求只有通过 foundry / memory / logic 客户的实际资本开支，进一步落到 WFE、EUV / DUV、deposition、etch、process control、advanced packaging 等设备类别，才会转成设备商的 bookings、backlog、shipment 和 service revenue。ASML 的关键在 EUV/DUV 订单、installed base service 和先进制程客户节奏；AMAT / LRCX / KLAC 的关键更偏工艺步骤暴露、存储周期、晶圆厂利用率、客户集中度和服务收入韧性。若只有 peer group、行业关系图谱或 AI 需求叙事，最多只能支持 research scope，不能当成订单周期和利润改善的主证据。

promotable_boundaries: Company RPO/ARR/cloud growth can support monetization.
Developer ecosystem can support adoption context but not revenue exact.
forbidden_inferences: Do not equate AI product launch with monetized revenue.
Do not treat capex growth alone as positive without margin/depreciation bridge.
contracts.answer_exemplar: Cloud / SaaS 的 AI 投资不能简单写成“AI 产品发布，所以公司会增长”。AI 同时是需求入口和成本压力。对 Microsoft、Amazon、Google 这类云厂商，capex 和 GPU / data center 支出先进入资产负债表和折旧，再通过 Azure / AWS / Google Cloud revenue、usage growth、AI workload attach、enterprise contract、RPO、gross margin 和 operating margin 体现回报。若只有 capex 增加而缺 monetization 指标，结论应是 bounded：AI 提供增长期权，但短期可能压制 FCF 和 margin。

role_contract.main_fail_mode: AI product launch treated as monetization proof

promotable_boundaries: Balance-sheet rows can support financial quality.
Macro rate series can support context and sensitivity, not issuer-specific NIM by itself.
forbidden_inferences: Do not analyze banks only by revenue or EPS.
Do not infer credit loss improvement from stock price movement.
contracts.answer_exemplar: 银行和券商类金融公司的分析不能停在 revenue / EPS。利率上行也不是线性利好，关键要看资产端收益率重定价和负债端存款成本、存款流失、批发融资成本之间的差。合格结论应当是资产负债表驱动的：如果高利率提高资产收益但存款成本和信用损失上升更快，NIM 或 ROE 可能并不改善；如果贷款增长弱但信用质量恶化，收入韧性也可能掩盖未来拨备压力。宏观利率和 FDIC/FRED 数据只能提供环境，不能替代 issuer-level deposit、loan、capital、credit rows。

role_contract.main_fail_mode: bank analyzed like industrial revenue/EPS case

promotable_boundaries: Regulatory approval can support product existence and eligibility.
Procedure/adoption proxy can support directional context but not market share exact.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer sales share from trial existence.
Do not convert FDA context into revenue exact.
contracts.answer_exemplar: 医药和医疗器械不能把 trial、FDA 或产品存在直接写成销售成功。产品/适应症先要有 clinical evidence 或 regulatory pathway，再看 label、payer / reimbursement、医生或医院采用、产能/渠道、procedure volume 或 prescription/usage proxy，最后才进入 revenue、gross margin 和 pipeline optionality。ClinicalTrials / openFDA / FDA approval 能支持产品存在、研发阶段、适应症和监管路径，但不能直接支持处方量、市场份额或产品收入。

role_contract.main_fail_mode: regulatory eligibility treated as commercial performance

promotable_boundaries: Company capex/debt/cash-flow rows can support quality judgment.
Data-center demand proxy can support load direction but not exact contract economics.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat AI power demand as automatic earnings growth.
Do not ignore financing and regulatory constraints.
contracts.answer_exemplar: AI data center 用电增长不能直接写成公用事业利润增长。对 regulated utility，负荷增长只有在进入 rate base、capex plan、transmission/distribution investment、allowed ROE 和 rate case 后，才会变成较可见的长期 earnings base；同时 capex 扩张也会带来债务、利息、股权融资和监管滞后风险。若只有 EIA/电价/AI 用电新闻，则只能支持需求背景，不能直接推断 EPS、ROE 或股价上行。

role_contract.main_fail_mode: AI power demand headline treated as EPS proof

promotable_boundaries: Company traffic/ticket/SSS rows can support operating analysis.
Macro and channel proxy can support context but not POS exact.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer sell-through exact from generic consumer proxy.
Do not treat price increases as unit demand without traffic/volume evidence.
contracts.answer_exemplar: Retail / consumer 的收入增长必须拆成 traffic、ticket、price/mix、unit volume、store expansion 和 promotion。同样是 revenue growth，同店销售靠客流增长和会员/复购支撑，比靠价格或促销更健康；gross margin 改善如果来自 freight relief 或 shrink 改善，和来自价格转嫁的可持续性不同。公开源下可用的是公司披露 operating KPI、同店销售、traffic/ticket、库存、毛利、宏观消费和渠道 proxy；公开 proxy 可以帮助判断方向，但不能冒充 sell-through exact。

role_contract.main_fail_mode: revenue growth not decomposed into traffic/ticket/mix/margin

promotable_boundaries: Disclosed deliveries and inventory can support operating quality.
Recall data can support product quality/risk context.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer margin quality from delivery volume alone.
Do not infer ASP exact from channel commentary without disclosed row.
contracts.answer_exemplar: Auto / EV 不能只看 deliveries，工业公司也不能只看订单标题。交付量增长如果伴随 ASP 下滑、库存上升、激励增加或融资成本上升，利润质量可能下降；NHTSA recall、质量事件和产能利用率会影响产品风险和成本。合格答案应该区分“需求量”和“利润质量”：交付增长能证明产品或渠道有需求，但不能单独证明 margin 改善；ASP、mix、inventory days、warranty/recall、capacity utilization、financing rate 和 dealer/channel data 才能回答需求是否健康。

promotable_boundaries: Market signals can support price-in and risk-appetite context.
Corporate actions can support capital feedback analysis.
forbidden_inferences: Do not turn market positioning into investment advice.
Do not treat options or holder proxy as fundamental improvement.
contracts.answer_exemplar: 二级市场分析不是替代基本面，而是回答“好消息是否已经被定价，以及资金和资本结构是否会反过来影响公司”。基本面和产品证据回答“公司有没有变好”，市场资金面和资本反馈回答“市场是否已经给了这个价格、融资窗口是否改善、是否存在拥挤或事件风险”。如果估值已显著扩张、期权 implied move 很高、持仓拥挤或公司有潜在增发/可转债/解禁压力，即使基本面方向正确，也要降低短期 risk/reward。不能把这些写成面向外部用户的交易建议。

role_contract.main_fail_mode: business improvement not separated from price-in and capital feedback

gates.correct_response_pattern: 不能因为 NVIDIA 没拆 H100 / H200 / B200 / GB200 的 SKU 收入，就说产品层无法判断。NVIDIA 当前 AI accelerator 竞争力可以从 GPU 代际升级、显存/带宽/互联、CUDA / Networking / NVLink / InfiniBand 生态、客户部署、OEM AI server 配置、CoWoS/HBM 供应瓶颈和数据中心 capex 约束来判断。边界是：这些证据能支持产品能力强、采用真实、供应链有瓶颈、替代短期有限，不能直接推出 SKU revenue、ASP、shipment 或 share。

MSFT / AMZN / GOOGL / META capex 上升可以说明 AI infrastructure demand pool 真实存在，但不能直接说明这些钱流向了某一家 GPU、server OEM、semicap 或 power/cooling 公司。capex 增长提高了需求池可信度，NVDA / DELL / ASML / LRCX 的受益需要进一步看产品供给、客户部署、供应瓶颈和公司财务桥。没有这些桥时，只能写 bounded demand read-through，不能写 supplier allocation exact。

ProductRelationshipGraph 的价值是把研究路径打通，不是直接替代证据。图谱边能帮助解释 NVIDIA GPU、TSMC advanced packaging、HBM、DELL AI servers、hyperscaler capex、ASML/LRCX/AMAT/KLAC semicap 之间的机制，也能提示下一步 evidence search。它不能写成订单、收入、毛利或 backlog。图谱是 thesis map 和 evidence search guide，不是财务结论。

如果 ASML、TEL、Hon Hai、DART、本地交易所或公司 IR 的年报/季报/演示稿已经定位到，但表格、附注或数字没有被抽出来，正确结论不是“公开源没有数据”。正确结论是：source 存在，当前 parser / locator / local disclosure adapter 没能把它转成可审计 row。这个 gap 应写成 parser_gap、table_extraction_gap、local_filing_adapter_gap 或 source_route_runtime_gap，并触发具体 parser 修复。

如果 pre_memo_fact_selection、aggregate r7 或 writer payload 已经包含 LRCX revenue/capex、DELL ISG revenue、gross margin、operating income、working capital 或 capex rows，最终 memo 就不能写“缺少 LRCX/DELL 财务数据”。这不是数据缺失，而是 selector、projection、JudgmentCard、MemoLogicPlan 或 writer consumption 的内部传导失败。正确处理是 fail 并回溯最早 faulty layer。

公开网页、新闻、App Store 排名、电商 listing、招聘、开发者生态、channel availability 和政府/监管 proxy 可以支持方向性判断，但不能冒充 IDC、Gartner、IQVIA、NielsenIQ、POS sell-through、OPRA、borrow cost 或 app revenue 这类商业/授权数据。正确做法是保留公开 proxy 的研究价值，同时明确 exact commercial tracker gap；错误做法是把公开 proxy 填成 exact sales/share，或者因为没有商业 tracker 就整段拒答。

checks.finding: Hyperscaler capex demand pool has issuer-level evidence and remains bounded from supplier allocation.
Product architecture/spec/benchmark/deployment evidence is deep enough to support product capability judgment without SKU revenue.
Customer deployment/adoption evidence contains issuer/product/counterparty/config context beyond relationship scope.
DELL AI server orders/backlog/revenue visibility is bridged to margin quality, pass-through cost, working capital, and cash conversion.
Case-specific valuation/positioning/crowding/capital feedback material supports price-in analysis.
Counter-thesis covers capex digestion, substitution, margin dilution, concentration, export/control, and trigger conditions.

product_architecture_competition.judgment: NVIDIA remains the main external accelerator system bottleneck because GB200 is a rack-scale system, but AMD MI300/MI35x and Google TPU are real workload-specific substitutes.
product_architecture_competition.business_mechanism: Product evidence should be read as architecture, performance and adoption evidence, not as SKU revenue. The graph must connect GB200 -> Dell/Google cloud deployment, AMD -> memory-heavy competition, and TPU -> custom-silicon substitution.
product_architecture_competition.cannot_infer: Cannot infer SKU revenue, share, shipment, ASP or margin from specs/benchmarks/cloud surfaces.
product_architecture_competition.counter_read: If AMD/TPU production deployments broaden or GB200 deployment slips, NVIDIA pricing and allocation power weakens.
product_architecture_competition.what_would_change_view: Production deployments, procurement mix and pricing evidence would change the weight.

financial_quality.judgment: Dell has unusually visible AI server revenue demand, but the investment-quality question is margin conversion, not whether demand exists.
financial_quality.business_mechanism: The right bridge is orders/backlog -> shipments -> ISG revenue -> gross/operating margin -> cash conversion. Current public rows prove the first half and leave AI server mix, GPU pass-through and attach economics unresolved.
financial_quality.cannot_infer: Cannot call Dell AI server growth high-margin until AI server gross margin, GPU pass-through, attach rate and backlog conversion are disclosed.
financial_quality.counter_read: Revenue tailwind may be low-margin GPU pass-through, with working-capital pressure or customer concentration.
financial_quality.what_would_change_view: Improving ISG margin with backlog conversion and attach economics would strengthen Dell quality.

semicap_readthrough.judgment: AI read-through is strongest when split by mechanism: TSMC advanced node, ASML lithography/installed base, AMAT materials engineering and LRCX memory/HBM process intensity.
semicap_readthrough.business_mechanism: Peer group membership is not evidence. The product graph should map advanced-node/HBM/packaging demand into specific tool mechanisms and keep bookings/backlog/customer allocation as follow-up requirements.
semicap_readthrough.cannot_infer: Cannot infer AI-specific orders or customer allocation from broad revenue/margin alone.
semicap_readthrough.counter_read: Export controls, China exposure, memory/foundry cycle shifts, or missing bookings can break the read-through.
semicap_readthrough.what_would_change_view: Bookings/backlog by tool category, HBM/advanced packaging orders and customer concentration would change confidence.

customer_deployment.judgment: Dell and Google provide official deployment surfaces that make GB200 adoption plausible, but public evidence still needs customer/order/config mix for investment-grade deployment quality.
customer_deployment.business_mechanism: Dell XE9680/XE9712 and Google A4X prove product surfaces and cloud/OEM availability; they do not prove signed customer demand or Dell margin.
customer_deployment.cannot_infer: Cannot infer customer concentration, deployment scale, or revenue per customer.
customer_deployment.counter_read: Preview-stage cloud availability or concentrated mega orders could limit the adoption signal.
customer_deployment.what_would_change_view: Official customer deployments and GA cloud capacity would upgrade this lane.

market_price_in.judgment: The business chain is directionally positive, but recommendation quality is blocked by missing valuation, positioning, short/options, ETF flow and price-reaction data.
market_price_in.business_mechanism: Market lane should not invent price-in from fundamentals. It should make capital-feedback rows a required next pack before buy/sell recommendation.
market_price_in.cannot_infer: Cannot infer crowding, price-in or recommendation from business evidence alone.
market_price_in.counter_read: The thesis can be right fundamentally but already fully reflected in valuation and positioning.
market_price_in.what_would_change_view: Valuation percentile, 13F/ETF/insider/short/options and event reaction rows would unlock recommendation analysis.

risk_counterevidence.judgment: The strongest counter-thesis is not generic 'AI risk'; it is capex digestion, Dell margin dilution, AMD/TPU substitution, supply bottlenecks, export controls, concentration and price-in.
risk_counterevidence.business_mechanism: Each risk maps to a mechanism in the thesis chain: demand pool durability, product substitution, OEM margin bridge, supply capacity, policy constraints and market feedback.
risk_counterevidence.cannot_infer: Cannot quantify probability or valuation impact without follow-up data.
risk_counterevidence.counter_read: If Dell margin fails to improve or hyperscaler capex shifts to internal accelerators, the positive chain weakens.
risk_counterevidence.what_would_change_view: ISG margin, supplier allocation, TPU/AMD deployment and valuation/positioning data are the main trigger conditions.
